NOT_IN_STREAM_SETUP: The stream can only be started during stream setup.
ALREADY_RUNNING: A stream is already running. Please try again.
NO_WHIP_URL: The lobby has no stream address.
FFMPEG_MISSING: The video encoder component is missing. Restart the app to reinstall it.
CAPTURE_FAILED: Couldn't capture the selected source. Pick another one.
PIPELINE_ARGS: Invalid stream configuration. Check your stream settings.
FFMPEG_REJECTED_ARGS: The video encoder rejected its configuration. Please report this bug.
ENCODER_UNUSABLE: {{detail}} couldn't start. Pick a different encoder in settings.
NOT_LIVE: The stream didn't go live. Check your connection and try again.
STREAM_READY_FAILED: The stream started but the server wasn't notified. Try again.
